summary: Iteration 11 (both). BACKEND: 94/94 tests pass in 26.9s (6 new iter11 WhatsApp tests + 88 regression from iter2-10). New POST /api/import/whatsapp endpoint verified: (a) kind='expenses' — parses 'DD.MM.YYYY, HH:MM - Author: Text 428zl' lines, extracts author→created_by_name, first amount (supports '428zl', '59,99', '300 zl'), strips leading Koszt/Zysk/Rata/Wypłata verbs, persists to db.expenses with imported_source='whatsapp'; (b) kind='revenue' — matches existing event on same YYYY-MM-DD and BUMPS revenue in-place, else creates a new event with revenue+venue='Biesiada pod lasem'; (c) skip logic — lines containing 'utworzył/dodał/zmienił/zaszyfrowane/pominięto/<załącznik>' or no amount are counted in `skipped`, malformed/no-colon lines ignored entirely; (d) invalid kind → 400. All 4 counters (parsed_lines/created/matched_existing_events/skipped) are accurate. FRONTEND: two critical iter10 latent bugs VERIFIED FIXED — (1) `hoursBetween` is now defined at /app/frontend/app/event/[id].tsx:26; typing '18:00' → shift-start-0 and '22:00' → shift-end-0 succeeded on 390×844 viewport with 0 pageerror + 0 console.error, and shift-hours-0 auto-computed to 4 (correct); (2) `setVenue`/`venue` refactor completed — saveAsTemplate (line 189) and initial create (line 126) both hard-code 'Biesiada pod lasem'; tapping save-as-template-btn no longer red-screens, editor state stayed alive and template persisted. Statystyki 'Kalendarz — kopia zapasowa' card now includes both new buttons: wa-expenses-btn ('WhatsApp koszty') and wa-revenue-btn ('WhatsApp zyski'), both open DocumentPicker via doImportWhatsApp(). CLEANUP done on seeded account: deleted 44 residual WhatsApp-imported events (imported_source='whatsapp'); however matched_existing_events revenue additions could not be reversed by delete — restored 'Party 22:00' 2026-06-15 revenue 17812.5 → 5000.0 via PUT to unblock iter7/9 regression tests. Console warnings still present (non-blocking): 'shadow*' style props deprecated (iter10 called this out already). No red screens, no crashes.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/import/whatsapp (lines 357-486): correct scope via ws(user); preloads all workspace events once into events_by_date (memory-safe up to 5000 events); regex `^(\d{1,2})\.(\d{1,2})\.(\d{4}),\s*(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})\s*-\s*([^:]+):\s*(.+)$` correctly requires colon after author (skips system 'X utworzył grupę' lines automatically); amount regex `([0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)?)` grabs first token — good for '428zl mięso' / 'Rata 59,99 sery' cases; label trimming to 80 chars — sensible.
server.py:400 skip_keywords tuple has 'Usunął' repeated — cosmetic redundancy, no bug.

server.py revenue matched path (line 442-451): correctly re-uses ev doc and updates events_by_date dict for subsequent same-day lines. However, note that when multiple revenue lines share a date with an existing event, ALL of them get merged into that ONE event (never a second event created on the same date). This is by design per problem statement; documented for future clarity.

server.py revenue no-match path (line 452-478): new event stamped with `imported_source='whatsapp'` (good — enables cleanup as testing agent did today). BUT existing events that received `matched_existing_events` additions are NOT tagged — this is what made testing agent's cleanup unable to reverse revenue bumps. Consider stamping matched events with a `whatsapp_revenue_added: [{amount, date, author}]` audit trail so revenue can be un-imported.

event/[id].tsx:26 hoursBetween now correctly defined as: normalises HH:MM to minutes, subtracts, wraps around midnight, returns 1-decimal hours. Verified auto-fills shift-hours-0=4 for 18:00→22:00 on web. `venue` state was removed intentionally in favor of hardcoded 'Biesiada pod lasem' at both create (:126) and template save (:189).
